status: RECORDED - post hoc analysis added after the signed analysis was run; no change to the signed rule
what_was_observed: Under the signed parsing rule the second typing was unavailable at 14 of the 15 ChampHLA-Consensus error loci (5 RNA-seq, 9 WES) and matched the reference at the remaining one. Inspection of the raw IGSR values showed that the unavailable values carry a trailing asterisk (for example '07:01*'), which the IGSR README and the paper's S2 Table do not describe. The signed rule classes such values as non-numeric and therefore unavailable; that classification stands as the primary result.

post_hoc_analysis.rule: Strip a trailing asterisk and parse the value as in the signed rule. Report, per assay: exact-endpoint loci carrying an asterisk, how many are consensus-discordant, and at how many the asterisk-stripped typing equals the consensus call or the reference.
post_hoc_analysis.status: Post hoc and descriptive. Chosen after the signed results and the raw values were seen. The meaning of the asterisk is undocumented, so attribution of a discordance to reference error is reported only as 'may reflect'.

unchanged: The signed parsing rule, the adjudication classes and the reference-agreement sensitivity are reported exactly as specified.
No primary or secondary result changes.
